title: Enronry Tony - Master Services Agreement
author: Legal
owner: Priya Nair (Account Owner), David Osei (Delivery Lead)
body: Document ID: FEC-CTR-001. Contract type: Master Services Agreement (MSA). Purpose: This MSA governs all professional services Finance Evolution Corp provides to Enronry Tony and establishes the commercial and delivery framework for the engagement. Parties and ownership: The account owner responsible for the commercial relationship is Priya Nair. The delivery lead responsible for execution is David Osei. The client's primary contact is their Chief Operating Officer. Commercial terms: Total contract value is 240,000 USD annually, invoiced quarterly in advance at 60,000 USD per quarter. Payment terms are net 30 from invoice date. Late payments accrue interest at 1.5 percent per month. Term and renewal: The initial term runs from January 15, 2026 to January 14, 2027. The agreement auto-renews for successive one-year terms unless either party provides 60 days written notice before the renewal date. Obligations to execute: (1) Deliver a fortnightly steering committee report every other Friday by end of day. (2) Complete the initial platform rollout within 90 days of the kickoff date. (3) Maintain a named Technical Account Manager available during business hours. (4) Provide quarterly business reviews with documented success metrics. Service levels: A 99.5 percent monthly uptime commitment applies to any hosted components. If uptime falls below target, service credits apply at 5 percent of the quarterly fee per half-percentage-point missed, capped at 20 percent. Confidentiality: Each party must protect the other's confidential information for 3 years beyond termination. Termination: Either party may terminate for material breach with 30 days written notice and a cure period; fees are prorated to the termination date.

title: OKLightning Tony - Statement of Work: Platform Implementation
author: Professional Services
body: Document ID: FEC-CTR-002. Contract type: Statement of Work (SOW), fixed fee. Purpose: This SOW defines the scope, milestones, and payment schedule for a fixed-fee platform implementation delivered by Finance Evolution Corp to OKLightning Tony. Parties and ownership: The engagement manager who owns this contract end to end is Marcus Feld. OKLightning Tony must designate a named business owner and a technical point of contact within 5 business days of kickoff. Commercial terms: Fixed fee of 85,000 USD, billed against three milestones: 30 percent (25,500 USD) on kickoff, 40 percent (34,000 USD) on user acceptance testing sign-off, and 30 percent (25,500 USD) on go-live. Payment terms are net 30. Obligations to execute: (1) Complete discovery and requirements gathering within the first 3 weeks. (2) Deliver a fully configured staging environment by the end of Q1 2026. (3) Run two structured rounds of user acceptance testing with documented defect logs. (4) Provide 8 hours of administrator training before go-live. Timeline: Go-live is targeted for June 30, 2026. Client dependencies: OKLightning Tony must provide production data exports and environment access within 5 business days of kickoff; delays to these inputs extend delivery dates on a day-for-day basis. Change control: Work outside the documented scope requires a signed change request and is billed at 200 USD per hour. Acceptance: Each milestone is deemed accepted if no written objection is received within 5 business days of delivery.

title: FilterME Tony - Managed Services Retainer
author: Legal
body: Document ID: FEC-CTR-003. Contract type: Managed Services Retainer. Purpose: This retainer provides ongoing managed support and optimization services from Finance Evolution Corp to FilterME Tony. Parties and ownership: The Customer Success Manager who owns this account is Elena Rossi. FilterME Tony's primary contact is their VP of Operations. Commercial terms: The retainer is 12,000 USD per month covering up to 40 support hours per month. Unused hours do not roll over to the following month. Overage hours beyond 40 are billed at 180 USD per hour. Payment terms are net 15. Term and renewal: The initial term is 12 months from September 1, 2025 to August 31, 2026, renewing month to month after the initial term. Obligations to execute: (1) Respond to priority-one tickets within 2 hours during business hours. (2) Hold a monthly business review with the client's operations team. (3) Deliver a quarterly optimization report with recommendations. (4) Maintain a shared, up-to-date runbook for the client's environment. Service levels: Priority-one response target is 2 hours; priority-two is 1 business day. Missed priority-one response targets credit 2 percent of the monthly fee each, capped at 15 percent. Termination: Either party may terminate for convenience with 30 days written notice; the final month is prorated.

title: Pets Tony - Pilot Engagement Agreement
author: Sales
owner: Tom Becker (Account Executive), Sara Lindqvist (Solutions Architect)
body: Document ID: FEC-CTR-004. Contract type: Pilot Engagement Agreement, paid proof of concept. Purpose: This agreement covers a time-boxed 60-day paid pilot to evaluate Finance Evolution Corp's platform against agreed success criteria for Pets Tony. Parties and ownership: The account executive who owns the commercial relationship is Tom Becker. The solutions architect responsible for delivery is Sara Lindqvist. Commercial terms: The pilot fee is 25,000 USD, invoiced in full at the start of the pilot, net 30. The pilot fee is creditable toward a full annual contract if signed within 30 days of pilot completion. Term: The pilot runs from March 10, 2026 to May 9, 2026. Obligations to execute: (1) Stand up a dedicated sandbox environment within 5 business days of signing. (2) Define exactly three measurable success criteria jointly with the customer at kickoff. (3) Deliver a mid-pilot check-in at day 30 with a status against each success criterion. (4) Present a final results readout at day 60 with a documented go or no-go recommendation. Client dependencies: Pets Tony must provide representative sample data and two named evaluator users within the first week. Success measurement: The pilot is judged solely against the three success criteria documented and signed at kickoff. Conversion: If the customer proceeds, the pilot artifacts and configuration carry over into the production engagement.

title: AccountLink Tony - Premium Support and SLA Addendum
author: Legal
body: Document ID: FEC-CTR-005. Contract type: Premium Support and Service Level Addendum. Purpose: This addendum adds premium support coverage and binding service level commitments on top of AccountLink Tony's underlying agreement with Finance Evolution Corp. Parties and ownership: The owning Customer Success Manager is Elena Rossi, who also owns the FilterME Tony account. Commercial terms: Annual value is 48,000 USD, invoiced annually in advance, net 30. Term: The addendum covers calendar year 2026, January 1 to December 31. Obligations to execute: (1) Provide 24 by 7 coverage for priority-one incidents. (2) Guarantee a 1 hour response target and a 4 hour resolution target for priority-one incidents. (3) Assign a named support engineer as the primary point of contact. (4) Produce a monthly SLA compliance report showing response and resolution performance against target. Service levels and credits: For each priority-one incident that misses the resolution target, a service credit of 5 percent of the monthly fee applies, capped at 25 percent of the monthly fee in any single month. Escalation: Escalation contacts are reviewed and confirmed quarterly. Precedence: Where this addendum conflicts with the standard support terms in the underlying agreement, this addendum takes precedence.
